text:
Kira (People Ops): Quick heads-up — to smooth SOC2/ISO evidence review next week we're doing staggered upload blocks and a special-handling lane for vendor/contractor artifacts. Please read and sign up for a slot. :spiral_calendar:

Omar (Compliance): TL;DR: we need to avoid the usual last-minute bulk dump. Upload in your assigned 2-hour window, include the metadata checklist, and label files with `team-name_evidence_type_date`.

Lena (Eng): How are the slots assigned? My team has two people OOO on Tuesday.

Kira (People Ops): We'll publish slots by team headcount. If you have a scheduling constraint add a comment on the sign-up doc (link below) and we'll move you into the special-handling lane. Slots open Mon/Tue/Wed next week.

Sam (Infra): volunteering to help triage network and infra evidence between 10:00-12:00 Tue. :+1:

Maya (Vendor Ops): For vendor artifacts: please use the vendor-lane upload form. We need proof of contract, data flow diagram, and signed DPIA where applicable.

Omar (Compliance): Required evidence checklist (min set):
```
- Access control screenshots (IAM groups, role mappings)
- Change management ticket exports for related repos/services
- Deployment runbooks and rollback procedure (short PDF)
- Vendor contracts with security addendum (signed PDF)
- Data retention policy excerpt and example retention deletion log
- Privacy training attestations for named owners (CSV)
```
If something is genuinely missing, put a "missing-evidence" flag in the upload form and assign an owner + ETA.

Kira (People Ops): Link to sign-up doc + upload form: https://confluence.redwood.ai/teams/compliance/evidence-upload (use company SSO). Upload destination is the private S3 bucket — form submits the presigned URL automatically.

DevBot: Automated reminder will ping participants 24h and 2h before their slot. React with :bell: to subscribe to extra reminders.

Lena (Eng): If we accidentally upload wrong files, how do we revoke?

Sam (Infra): We can invalidate the presigned URL and reissue. Tag me and I'll revoke within 15m.

Kira (People Ops): Exceptions process: label as "exception-request" in the form, provide justification and ETA. Compliance will triage within 48 hours.

Maya (Vendor Ops): Note for contractor evidence — redacted PII only, do not upload raw logs with IPs or usernames. Use the redaction checklist in the form.

Omar (Compliance): Final deadline for the sprint is Friday EOD, but upload windows are prioritized earlier. Missing items after Friday may require formal attestation exceptions.

Kira (People Ops): Call to action: leads, please open the sign-up doc by EOD today and assign your team's slot. If you can't, DM me and Omar. Thanks! :pray: 

Sam (Infra): Got it. I'll own infra lane Tue 10-12 and help revoke/replace any bad uploads.

Lena (Eng): I'll add our slot and note two people OOO — request special-handling if you can't fit us.

DevBot: Reminder scheduled for 24h before each slot.

Kira (People Ops): small follow-up — we'll run a 30m QA sweep Wed afternoon to spot-check uploads. If you want your artifacts reviewed pre-upload ping #eng-qa and we'll review quickly.

Maya (Vendor Ops): tagging vendors now so they see the vendor-lane requirements.

Omar (Compliance): Thank you everyone — this reduced friction plan worked well in the pilot. Let's keep it tight.
